message.reasoning_content:
We need to identify crimes based on the fact: In early May 23, 2010, defendant Zhang4 and others, driving a three-wheeled motorcycle, stole a blue "Feicai" brand motorized three-wheeler valued at 3000 yuan from a villager.

Thus theft of a motor vehicle. Under Chinese Criminal Law, theft of a motor vehicle is "盗窃罪" (theft). If the value is 3000 yuan, maybe qualifies as "盗窃罪" (theft) but also could be "抢劫罪"? No, no violence. So theft. Also "共同盗窃罪"? The law treats joint theft as theft, but the participants are co-perpetrators. So the crime is "盗窃罪". Also possibly "非法持有、使用枪支弹药罪"? No. So only theft.

Thus answer: [盗窃罪]<eoa>. Use format: [罪名] and <eoa>. They want multiple separated by ';' if multiple. Only one.

Thus final.
